title: What extra money buys on a step curve
heading: Tell Finance the Steps, Not a Rate
cases: from inside a flat stretch, the gain is the value at budget + extra less the value at budget, with the steps crossed and the next step
a budget exactly at a step point already has that step's value
the next step is the first one strictly above the budget, never the step it stands on
below the first point there is no plan, so there is no answer
